title: High-Foot Leg Press
summary: A leg press with your feet high on the platform to shift the work toward the glutes and adductors.

muscles.why: Library rating 0.9 for glutes (main mover): each working set adds 0.9 of a set to the weekly glutes total.
Library rating 0.7 for quads (helper): each working set adds 0.7 of a set to the weekly quads total.
Library rating 0.6 for adductors (helper): each working set adds 0.6 of a set to the weekly adductors total.
Library rating 0.3 for hamstrings (minor): each working set adds 0.3 of a set to the weekly hamstrings total.

setup.text: Put your feet high and a bit wide on the platform.
Lower until your hips are deeply flexed, keeping your hips on the seat.
Press through your heels to the top.

form_cues.cue: Lower deep while keeping the back on the pad
Stop before your tailbone curls off the pad.

mistakes.text: Letting the lower back peel off the pad.

lower_risk.text: Warm-up: the app adds two or three ramp-up sets at rising loads before the first working set, unless that load is very light.
The app suggests a heavier load only when the jump is 5% or less; otherwise it adds a rep first.
Default target: 6-10 reps, stopping about 3 reps short of failure (RIR 3). Stop the set when form breaks down.
Use the same controlled range on every rep; lower under control rather than dropping or bouncing.
Pick a variation and range you can train comfortably.

alternatives.why: Swap sheet: Less stretch emphasis, More quad-focused, One side at a time.

notes: Ratings, swap attributes and cues are the library model (modeled). An authored page will replace this one.
